title: HELIX Position Resource
description: A position — the organizational 'seat' defined independently of who fills it. Carries job profile, supervisory org, compensation grade, EEO category, and funding source. Workday position-management model.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this Position record.

position_title.description: Position-specific title if overridden, otherwise from job profile.

job_profile.description: Workday Job Profile = PS Job Code. The classification template.

job_family.description: Grouping of related job profiles. E.g., 'Information Technology', 'Faculty - Arts & Sciences'.

job_level.description: Map to institutional level structure or HELIX level codes.

supervisory_org.description: The org unit this position reports into.

incumbent_ref.description: Resolve to HELIX employee_id if position is filled.

headcount.description: Number of workers that can fill this position (usually 1).

eeo_job_category.description: Map to IPEDS EEO category for federal reporting. E.g., 'Executive/Admin/Managerial', 'Faculty', 'Professional', 'Clerical', 'Technical', 'Skilled Craft', 'Service/Maintenance'.

fund_code.description: Map to HELIX fund code. Faculty positions on grants → restricted fund.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
